SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
（印：SP. BR. REGISTER 911 13 6 141）
S.I. Special Branch Statistical File No.................... Date June 13, 1941.
SUBJECT: Julius MARCUS
Julius Marcus was Far Eastern Salesman for the Pagoda Hosiery Company from 1928 to 1936. In addition, he was, from 1933 to 1936, the Shanghai Manager of Messrs. El Oriente Fabrica de Tabacos Inc., Manila, P.I.
On May 1st 1936, a complaint was received from the President of the above tobacco company, accusing Julius Marcus of misappropriation. The case, however, was dropped and Marcus left the firm.
He lived for some time following this with Mr. Tobias, partner of Lazarus Opticians, 126 Nanking Road. Mr. Tobias practically supported Marcus who was in very straitened circumstances. Marcus later became ill and was admitted to the General Hospital where he died, aged 56, of cancer on March 17th, 1937.
He was buried in Baikal Road Cemetery, the cost of which was borne by the Shanghai Jewish Communal Association. The deceased's effects, a few articles of clothing, were handed over to the above Association by order of the British Consular Authorities. A death certificate was issued by H.B.M. Consul, Mr. (now Sir A) Blackburn.
Among the deceased's effects were two documents, a British Passport No. 7996, issued at Singapore on 11-3-31, and a Commonwealth of Australia Certificate of Naturalization No. 19272.
These, together with the death certificate, were handed to H.B.M. Passport Officer by Mr. J.J. McGeown, British Supreme Court Marshal.
Mr. Cox, H.B.M. Passport Officer, has been

报告
（印章：特别处登记簿 911 1941年6月13日）
特别处统计档案编号.................... 日期：1941年6月13日。
事由：朱利叶斯·马库斯（Julius MARCUS）
朱利叶斯·马库斯于1928年至1936年间担任宝塔袜业公司（Pagoda Hosiery Company）的远东销售员。此外，他于1933年至1936年间还担任菲律宾群岛马尼拉市东方烟草制造股份有限公司（Messrs. El Oriente Fabrica de Tabacos Inc., Manila, P.I.）的上海经理。
1936年5月1日，收到上述烟草公司总裁的投诉，指控朱利叶斯·马库斯挪用公款。然而，该案随后被撤销，马库斯离开了该公司。
此后一段时间，他与南京路126号拉扎勒斯眼镜行（Lazarus Opticians）的合伙人托拜厄斯先生（Mr. Tobias）同住。马库斯当时境况十分窘迫，几乎全靠托拜厄斯先生接济。马库斯后来患病，入住广慈医院（General Hospital），并于1937年3月17日因癌症去世，享年56岁。
他被安葬在贝加尔路公墓（Baikal Road Cemetery），费用由上海犹太社团协会承担。死者的遗物（几件衣物）根据英国领事当局的命令移交给上述协会。死亡证明书由英国驻华领事布莱克本先生（Mr. (now Sir A) Blackburn，现为A爵士）签发。
在死者遗物中有两份文件：一本英国护照，号码7996，1931年3月11日于新加坡签发；以及一份澳大利亚联邦归化证书，号码19272。
这些文件连同死亡证明书已由英国最高法院法警 J.J. McGeown 先生移交给英国护照官员。
考克斯先生（Mr. Cox），英国护照官员，已获悉

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL
SHANGHAI

5th June, 1941.
911
13 6 41

Dear Mr. Sharman,

I have received the enclosed letter
from Mrs. Ruby Marcus enquiring as to the
whereabouts of her husband, Julius Marcus,
who was last heard of in Shanghai in 1930.

I cannot find any record of his name
in my files nor does he appear to have been
registered as a British subject at this Consulate-
General.

I should be grateful for any information,
negative or otherwise, which you can give me to
enable me to reply to Mrs. Marcus' letter.

Once again many thanks for your help.

Yours sincerely,

V. Sharman, Esquire,
Assistant Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

英国驻上海总领事馆
上海

1941年6月5日。
911
13 6 41

亲爱的夏曼先生：

我收到了随函附上的鲁比·马库斯夫人（Mrs. Ruby Marcus）的来信，询问其丈夫朱利叶斯·马库斯的下落，此人最后一次在上海有消息是在1930年。

我在档案中找不到任何关于他姓名的记录，他似乎也未在本总领事馆登记为英国臣民。

如您能提供任何信息（无论有无结果），以便我回复马库斯夫人的来信，我将不胜感激。

再次感谢您的帮助。

此致

敬礼

V. Sharman 先生，
助理总监，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

"San Remo",
7, Pen Rivil Street,
Bondi,
Sidney.
N.S.W. Australia,
26th April, 1941.

Register of Deaths,
Shanghai.

Dear Sirs,

Having had no word of my husband
for eleven years and not being able to get any
news of his whereebouts I fell sure something
must have happened to him. I would like to know
if you have any record of his death on your books.

Julius Marcus, was born in Strasbourg
in 1881 and was last heard of in Shanghai in August
1930.

Hoping to hear from you at your
earliest convenience.

Yours truly,

(Mrs.) Ruby Marcus

新南威尔士州，澳大利亚，
1941年4月26日。

上海死亡登记处。

诸位先生：

我已十一年未收到丈夫的任何音讯，且无法得知其下落，我确信他一定出了什么事。我想了解贵处登记簿上是否有他的死亡记录。

朱利叶斯·马库斯于1881年出生于斯特拉斯堡，最后一次在上海有消息是在1930年8月。

盼早日复信。

此致

敬礼

鲁比·马库斯夫人（Mrs. Ruby Marcus）
